reply_text:
I've replied to Marcus in our DM. I found one of the two answers.

- **Door 14 scanner ticket:** it's **#4419**. Thea Ramaswell logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It has since gone to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The source is the North team's undated cheat sheet in the shared files. I also warned Marcus not to mix it up with #PD-4492. That was another of Thea's tickets, about drivers at Doors 14–18 not getting text messages with their bay assignments, and it was fixed in October 2025.
- **Osprey rollout deadline and main contact:** I couldn't find this anywhere Marcus has access to. I checked every channel he's in, our DM and the shared files, and there's no Quarrendon account folder in the files. I told him that rather than guessing, and suggested he ask Dana or Ilse in case it was settled on a call or by email. I also noted that the cheat sheet lists Thea Ramaswell as Quarrendon's main contact overall, though nothing links her to Osprey.

I only read channels Marcus belongs to and didn't use message search. No approvals were needed.
